mapper.sql: s.id, s.spu_id as material_id, s.spec_json as spec_values, s.sku_code, s.purchase_decimal, s.commodity_decimal, s.wholesale_decimal, s.market_price, s.low_decimal, s.default_flag, s.image_url as img_url, s.create_time, s.create_serial, s.update_serial, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(s.update_time)*1000 as update_time, s.tenant_id, case when s.deleted_at is null then '0' else '1' end as delete_flag
mapper.select: select s.id, s.spec_json as spec_values, m.bar_code as bar_code, m.unit as commodity_unit, s.spec_json as sku, s.sku_code, s.commodity_decimal, s.purchase_decimal, s.wholesale_decimal, s.market_price, s.low_decimal, s.default_flag, s.image_url as img_url, s.tenant_id, IFNULL(cs.current_stock,0) as current_stock, w.low_safe_stock as low_safe_stock, w.high_safe_stock as high_safe_stock, w.depot_id as depot_id from sku s left join jsh_material m on s.spu_id = m.id left join ( select sku_id, sum(current_number) as current_stock from jsh_material_current_stock where ifnull(delete_flag,'0') !='1' and sku_id is not null group by sku_id ) cs on s.id = cs.sku_id left join ( select sku_id, max(depot_id) as depot_id, max(low_safe_stock) as low_safe_stock, max(high_safe_stock) as high_safe_stock from jsh_material_initial_stock where ifnull(delete_flag,'0') !='1' and sku_id is not null group by sku_id ) w on s.id = w.sku_id where s.spu_id = #{materialId} and s.deleted_at is null order by s.default_flag desc, s.id asc
select from sku s where s.spu_id = #{materialId} and s.deleted_at is null order by s.default_flag desc, s.id asc
select from sku s where s.spu_id = #{materialId} and s.deleted_at is null and s.default_flag = #{defaultFlag} order by s.id asc
select s.id from sku s where s.spu_id = #{materialId} and s.deleted_at is null and s.default_flag = #{defaultFlag} order by s.id asc limit 1
select from sku s where s.sku_code = #{skuCode} and s.deleted_at is null order by s.id asc limit 1
mapper.update: update sku set purchase_decimal = #{purchaseDecimal,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, commodity_decimal = #{commodityDecimal,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, wholesale_decimal = #{wholesaleDecimal,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, low_decimal = #{lowDecimal,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, market_price = #{marketPrice,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, version = version + 1 where id = #{id,jdbcType=BIGINT} and deleted_at is null
